# Isaiah Chapter 54 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 17 verses]*

*Sing O barren one; your Maker is your husband; taught by the LORD; no weapon shall prosper*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** No weapon that is fashioned against you shall succeed. This chapter sing o barren one.

*-- LOGOS*
